name: Weblisk Framework
description: Structural and security requirements every Weblisk blueprint must satisfy. Generated from the blueprint schema definitions.
scope: Blueprints, and the code, agents and platforms implementing them

families.name: Agent blueprints
families.description: Structure required of an infrastructure agent blueprint

controls.name: Endpoints
controls.description: HTTP surface beyond the six protocol endpoints. Required if the agent serves any — same shape and rules as schemas/architecture.md

controls.name: Triggers
controls.description: Events, schedules, messages that activate the agent

controls.name: Constraints
controls.description: Blast radius, forbidden actions, resource limits

controls.name: Observability
controls.description: Logs, metrics, alerts. Three collections — customlogtypes, metrics, alerts — which no single table can carry; see the Section Specification

controls.name: Test Fixtures
controls.description: Happy path, error cases, edge cases

families.name: Domain controllers
families.description: Structure required of a domain controller specification

controls.name: Domain Manifest
controls.description: JSON manifest with capabilities, inputs, outputs, required agents

controls.name: Required Agents
controls.description: Table of agents this domain dispatches to

controls.name: Aggregation
controls.description: How results from agents are combined

controls.name: Scoring
controls.description: Required if domain produces scored reports

families.name: Wire protocols
families.description: Structure required of a protocol specification

controls.name: Endpoints
controls.description: Required for protocols that define HTTP endpoints

controls.name: Types
controls.description: Data structures in YAML. Required only where the blueprint declares types — a protocol that references another's registry states that and does not restate it

controls.name: Authentication
controls.description: Required for protocols that define auth

families.name: Cross-cutting patterns
families.description: Structure required of a pattern contract

controls.name: Types
controls.description: Data structures in YAML (if pattern defines types)

families.name: Architecture components
families.description: Structure required of a system architecture component

controls.name: Declaration
controls.description: Everything machine-read, in one block. Required once migrated — see CONTRACTBLOCKPLAN.md

controls.name: Responsibilities
controls.description: What this component owns and does NOT own

controls.name: Endpoints
controls.description: HTTP surface as a table, with a required Operation column. Required if the component serves any — see below

controls.name: Data Flow
controls.description: How data moves through this component

controls.name: Types
controls.description: Data structures in YAML (if component defines types)

controls.name: Security
controls.description: Security posture, trust model, and boundaries

families.name: Platform bindings
families.description: Structure required of a platform implementation binding

controls.name: Overview
controls.description: Scope description, why this platform fits Weblisk

controls.name: Primitive Mapping
controls.description: Where each primitive the specification blueprints require comes from on this platform

controls.name: Service Mapping
controls.description: Which capabilities the platform provides, and which a component must implement

controls.name: Project Structure
controls.description: Directory layout for orchestrator and agents

controls.name: Build and Run
controls.description: Build commands, run commands, environment setup

controls.name: Platform-Specific Conventions
controls.description: Language idioms, concurrency model, IO patterns

controls.name: Type Mapping
controls.description: How schema types map to language types

controls.description: Test framework, test structure, CI guidance
